titolo: Baidu launches Unlimited-OCR-2 on Hugging Face with unlimited‑horizon parsing
descr: The new OCR model uses Sparse Reference Sliding Window Attention to handle ultra‑long documents and is available on Hugging Face, ModelScope and Baidu Cloud.
paragrafi: Baidu released Unlimited-OCR-2 on Hugging Face on 28 October 2026. The model page shows 109,519 downloads and 496 likes.
Unlimited-OCR-2 introduces Sparse Reference Sliding Window Attention (SR‑SWA), which limits attention to a fixed set of 512 reference tokens regardless of document length.
The model claims state‑of‑the‑art results on long‑document benchmarks such as MPDocBench and the newly released MarathonDocBench, which targets hundred‑page parsing.
It is distributed under an MIT license and can be run with Transformers or the recommended SGLang serving stack.
Baidu made the model available on ModelScope, Baidu Cloud and a Hugging Face Space demo created by AK.
perche: Unlimited-OCR-2 lets developers parse multi‑page documents in a single request, reducing latency and memory use for very long texts.
